zoe: heads-up: found deterministic repeat at ~9.9k tokens on nova9b-int4 when rotary index wraps. short sessions fine.
mike: can you share a repro command?
zoe: curl -s -X POST https://int.redwood/api/generate -d '{"model":"nova9b-int4","prompt":"<long convo>","max_tokens":3000}' -> append until ~9900 tokens then next tokens repeat text from ~4900.
dev-bot: ci/longwrap/nova9b-int4 run complete. mismatch-rate 0.9% vs f16. artifacts: ci://artifacts/3100004321/logs
mike: sounds like index packing/truncation in compact int4 kvcache. try KV_SAFE_UNPACK or KV_FULL_INDEXING on canary.
zoe: enabled KV_FULL_INDEXING on canary; mismatch -> 0.01%, latency +3%.
mike: short term: route long sessions to int8 variant. long term: patch pack/unpack to mask/truncate safely and add fuzz tests at wrap boundary.
zoe: PR opened with unit & fuzz tests. scheduling nightly replay of failing trace to guard. thanks :thumbsup:
